'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' is an [[NPC]] on {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} in the [[Rift Dimension]] who gives the player a {{Skill|Fishing}}-related quest outside the Rift in exchange for {{Item|Eleanor's Tunic}}.

== Purpose ==
'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' gives the player a [[Fishing]] quest that must be completed outside the Rift.

Behind the nearby mirror, a replica of the player is shown fishing in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} while equipped with {{Item|Sponge Armor}} and a {{Lv|1}} {{Item|Flying Fish Pet|rarity=leg}}.

To complete the quest, all of the following conditions must be met at the same time:
*Wearing one of the following full Armor Sets:
** {{Item|Sponge Armor}}, {{item|Shark Scale Armor}}, {{Item|Nutcracker Armor}}
** {{Item|Gold Hunter Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, {{Item|Diamond Hunter Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, 
** {{Item|Diver's Armor}}, {{item|Abyssal Armor}};
** {{Item|Thunder Armor}}with {{item|Thunderbolt Necklace}}; 
** {{item|Magma Lord Armor}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, with {{item|Magma Lord Necklace}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}}.
*Equipping a [[Flying Fish Pet]] or [[Ammonite Pet]] of {{Legendary}} rarity or higher.
*Holding any [[Fishing Rod]].
*Being inside the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}} while within the coordinates {{coords|-130|195|-94}} and {{coords|-172|214|-49}}.
**The location is in a cave that can be accessed at {{coords|-121|205|-60}}.
*Splashing themselves with any potion.

Once completed, the message "''{{Mctxt|f|You sense a watchful presence...}}''" will appear in chat. The player can then return to '''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth IX''' to claim {{Item|Eleanor's Tunic}}.
